systemic_findings: Named species leaders and background aliens need entity-level matching rather than generic morphology fallback.
Physical releases of a group, band, scene, or vehicle do not imply every associated character was physically produced.
Recurring digital appearances across multiple LEGO games remain separate from physical-release evidence.
Very low-score unrelated candidates should resolve to no physical match.
